name: Mai's Training

journal.raw:
Mai at A Split Road seems like a martial arts specialist who can train beginners.
I am now under the tutelage of the famous sword master, Mai, in A Split Road. For my first lesson, she told me to hunt Blue Snails, Shrooms, and Red Snails. Ah, Mai also said to meet up with Biggs in Southperry for a useful quest.
Mai trained you, and you feel stronger.

lines.text: Hmm, you look like you're in serious need of my guidance. Is it your first time here? What you need more than anything right now is FOCUS. So...want me to train you?

segments.text: Hmm, you look like you're in serious need of my guidance. Is it your first time here? What you need more than anything right now is FOCUS. So...want me to train you?

lines.text: It's simple actually. All you need to do right now is hunt monsters. I'll assign you a few tasks, and you'll be surprised to see how much you grow.

segments.text: It's simple actually. All you need to do right now is hunt monsters. I'll assign you a few tasks, and you'll be surprised to see how much you grow.

lines.text: Head out of town, and you'll run into lots of monsters. The weakest is the Blue Snail, a tiny blue snail, and it's a piece of cake. Next are the Shrooms and the Red Snails. Listen, hunt weaker monsters until you can handle bigger, stronger, and faster monsters. It's all about hunting the right ones.

lines.text: Your training task is to defeat 10 Blue Snail, 10 Shroom, and 5 Red Snail and then return. It may seem tough at first, but you'll be able to do it quickly, so don't worry. Just remember to start with the weaker ones and take it slow! Staying calm is the key to hunting!
